message.content:
**Online book‑stores that carry *“To Kill a Mockingbird”* (Harper Collins)**  

| Store | Typical formats available | Notes |
|-------|---------------------------|-------|
| **Amazon.com** | Hardcover, paperback, Kindle eBook, Audible audiobook | Most widely stocked; free shipping on Prime members. |
| **Barnes & Noble (B&N)** | Hardcover, paperbacks, Nook eBooks | B&N’s own digital format plus physical copies. |
| **Book Depository** | Hardcover, paperback | Free worldwide delivery – great for international buyers. |
| **IndieBound / local independent booksellers** | Usually hardcover/paperback | Supports small shops via the IndieBound network. |
| **Google Play Books / Apple Books** | Digital ebook | Instant download; no physical copy. |
| **Audible/Spotify (for audiobooks)** | Audiobook version | If you prefer listening rather than reading. |

> All of these sites typically have both U.S. and international editions, so check your country’s specific site for pricing and shipping details.
